answer: Tie earning to accurate jury duty. At beacon-drawn times each identity is handed grading tasks due before a deadline; its verdict is mirrored against settled consensus, and divergence or a miss slashes a ferrous non-withdrawable stake. Mining is gated on a rolling accuracy score, so an identity that generates text but cannot judge peers stops earning. A farm must field a competent grader on every alias, not just a generator, and cannot predict which is called. Clones sharing one model mirror each other's verdicts, flagged by correlation. Cost scales with real judgment per identity, not keys.
